summary.headline: Mercury’s Visibility in the Signs
summary.text: Al-Kindi’s astrological judgments for Mercury’s eastern and western visibility, including general effects and sign-specific omens from Aries through Scorpio: disease, rain, warfare, deaths of rulers and officials, false rumors, and public unrest.
